Israel 'trampling on humanity's shared values': Türkiye's Erdogan

Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan said Israel was trampling on humanity's shared values through crimes against humanity.

Communications Director Burhanettin Duran said Erdogan had written an article for Kazinform during his visit to Astana.

The article followed the sixth meeting of the Türkiye-Kazakhstan High-Level Strategic Cooperation Council.
